review.tagline: Annotated PyTorch implementations of deep learning papers with side-by-side notes
review.summary: A collection of short PyTorch implementations of neural network architectures and algorithms, each rendered on nn.labml.ai as code beside explanatory notes. It covers transformers (including Flash Attention in Triton, RoPE, ALiBi), LoRA, diffusion models, GANs, reinforcement learning, optimizers, normalization layers and more. Installable as the labml-nn pip package.
review.audience: Engineers and students learning how deep learning papers are implemented
strengths: Broad coverage: transformers, diffusion, GANs, RL, optimizers, normalization, LoRA, GNNs, CFR
Each implementation has side-by-side code and explanation on a hosted website
Compact PyTorch code that is readable for studying the original papers
MIT license; install with pip install labml-nn
weaknesses: Written for study, not as an optimized production library
No release tags; versioning is only via the pip package
Many entries cover older papers; recent architectures are sparse
README gives no hardware requirements beyond GPU notes for the GPT-NeoX examples
needs: Models: PyTorch, JAX (transformer example), Triton (Flash Attention)
